messages:
sam: Quick FYI 11 strict fncall validation enabled on canary route tool.exec_v5 and console shows a small spike in hard rejects (~0.65%). Looks partner-heavy.

jules: Which field is failing?

sam: Mostly the `out` shape. Example from logs:
```json
{
  "tool": "exec",
  "out": [{"id":"xyz"}],
  "meta": {"partner": "legacy-adap"}
}
```
Validator expects `out` -> object `{items: [...], total: int}`.

anya: Validator owner here. We enabled reject to catch regressions but didn't realize partner mix. Ops is getting noisy. Short-term options: revert, warn-mode, or route legacy partners to compat variant.

jules: Warn-mode + sampling seems safest now 1 we keep telemetry but avoid breaking callers. Also add partner tags to metrics so console can show partner skew.

anya: I can flip the gate to `soft_pass` for the canary route id. Plan: increment `fncall.schema_warns` with route+partner tags, return 200 with header `X-Redwood-Fncall: validation=warn`, and set `tool_passthrough:true`. Will also enable a 1% sample of failing payloads (PII-redacted) to s3://fncall/reject-samples/ with `ingest_origin:canary_warn`.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: soft-pass toggle requested by @anya for route tool.exec_v5 canary. CI quick-check passed. ETA ~5m.

parul: Console/product request: add a dashboard panel that breaks `fncall.schema_warns` by `meta.partner` and `route_id`, and highlight canary slices. Current model-level graphs hide partner concentration.

jules: I'll prototype a quarantine tag mapping partners -> tool-compat-v1 so ops can add offenders and route them immediately.

anya: Patch merged; soft_pass on for canary. Telemetry shows warns but no client 4xxs. Samples enabled. Will post a short incident note with counts after 24h.

sam: Thanks 1 follow-ups: jules validate routing perf; parul add dashboard panel + sample link; anya publish incident note. Re-evaluate in 24h. :white_check_mark:
